snippet.title: FEE3 2025: Fire Emblem Advance: Homecoming by Not Quite Rodents (Parr+Lumi)
snippet.description:
From the design team behind Drums of War and Dream of Five comes the latest, prettiest and most cohesive campaign yet, bringing tight, classical gameplay, a character-driven narrative, and a newfound emphasis on bringing spectacular weapons and obscure magics to bear to lay waste to your enemies. Throughout, the campaign stays in conversation with the common themes and elements of the series' early years, and explores how else a series reset might have looked.

So, will you help callow princess Bronwyn to reclaim her birthright across the sea? Will she become the scion of the Black Queen, as some dare hope and others fear? Or, with eyes unclouded by old enmity, can she forge a new path for her people? It's a story you've heard a dozen times before... but never quite like this.
